    MagnitudeConjecture.ObjectDeletion.exists_uniformControlFamily_and_residuallySeparatedWindow_for_threeStepDeletionStages

    Uniform residual separation for object-deletion stages #

    The manuscript first chooses one finite module family controlling every intermediate object-deletion stage and then uses residual finiteness once on that family. This file joins those two already formalized steps: the subgroup is independent of the deletion stage, and its nonidentity shifted Homs vanish on the entire additive closure of the common control family.

    One application of residual finiteness separates the common finite control family selected from all realized survivor signatures. This is the formal conjunction of the manuscript's finite-union step and its choice of the normal finite-index subgroup Γ.
